model_notes.legacy_sweep: Reproduce original: >=90% coverage, confirming-close entry, raw fractional stop, next-bar stop activation; final available close exit; incomplete parents can enter ATR; partial 4H bars enter ATR.
model_notes.strict_sweep: 100% minute coverage, observed complete-parent ATR history reset after bad parents/contract changes, no partial 4H ATR bars, next-minute-open entry, tick-rounded stop active on entry minute, earlier opposite touch required.
model_notes.strict_plain: Same strict assumptions, first close beyond OR boundary, no prior-sweep requirement.

rule_selection: For every family/start-time/side and model, choose maximum development mean net points among settings with >=100 development trades. Ties: more trades, shorter opening range, shorter ATR. Never select using later results. Later dates were already examined in prior work, not untouched.
